name: power transmission element
meaning: a part that carries rotation or force from one part to another

name: pulley
meaning: a wheel on a shaft or a bearing whose rim takes a belt, a rope or a chain

name: crankshaft pulley
meaning: a pulley fixed on an engine's crankshaft that drives its belts, often carrying a torsional vibration damper

name: idler pulley
meaning: a pulley that turns freely on its own bearing, guiding or tensioning a belt and driving nothing

name: sheave
meaning: a grooved wheel that holds a rope or a cable

name: pulley rim
meaning: the outer ring of a pulley, which carries the grooves its belt runs in

name: hub
meaning: the central part of a wheel, a pulley or a gear, by which it is fixed to a shaft or turns on a bearing

name: V-belt
meaning: a belt of trapezoidal section that runs in a pulley's V-groove

name: gear
meaning: a wheel with teeth that meshes with another's to carry rotation

name: shaft
meaning: a bar, usually round, that turns and carries the parts fixed on it

name: shaft coupling
meaning: a part that joins two shafts end to end, so that one drives the other

name: bearing
meaning: a part that lets one part turn or slide on another, carrying the load between them

name: ball bearing
meaning: a rolling bearing whose rolling elements are balls held between two rings

name: deep groove ball bearing
meaning: a ball bearing whose rings have deep raceway grooves, carrying a radial load and some axial load either way

name: bushing
meaning: a sleeve in which a shaft or a rod turns or slides: a plain bearing, without rolling elements

name: seal
meaning: a part that keeps a fluid in, or dirt out, where two parts meet

name: O-ring
meaning: a ring of round section seated in a groove, which seals as it is pressed

name: X-ring
meaning: a ring of four-lobed section seated as an O-ring is, with two sealing lips on each side

name: radial shaft seal
synonyms: lip seal | lip oil seal | oil seal
meaning: a lip seal around a turning shaft, its lip pressed on the shaft by its own spring

name: rod seal
meaning: a seal around a cylinder's piston rod, which keeps the pressure in

name: wiper seal
meaning: a seal at a cylinder's mouth that scrapes dirt off the rod as it goes in

name: PTFE seal
meaning: a seal whose sliding ring is of PTFE, pressed on its counterface by an elastic ring beneath it

name: wear ring
meaning: a ring on a piston or in a gland that guides the moving part and keeps metal off metal

name: gasket
meaning: a seal pressed between two faces that do not move

name: blind plug
meaning: a plug that closes a port or a drilled passage for good

name: cap
meaning: a cover that closes an opening of a part, a bearing's or a tube's end, against dirt

name: fastener
meaning: a part that joins or holds parts together

name: screw
meaning: a fastener with an external thread

name: retaining ring
meaning: a ring seated in a groove that keeps a part from sliding along a shaft or a bore

name: circlip
meaning: a split retaining ring sprung into its groove, with holes for the pliers that fit it

name: dowel pin
meaning: a plain pin that locates one part on another

name: rivet
meaning: a permanent fastener whose shank is upset to hold the parts

name: washer
meaning: a thin plate with a hole that spreads a fastener's load or locks it

name: fluid power element
meaning: a part of a machine that works by a fluid under pressure

name: hydraulic cylinder
meaning: an actuator whose piston a liquid under pressure pushes along a tube

name: cylinder tube
meaning: the barrel of a hydraulic cylinder, in which its piston slides

name: piston
meaning: the part that slides in a cylinder, moved by the pressure on it or moving it

name: piston rod
meaning: the rod that joins a piston to what it moves, passing out of the cylinder

name: gland
meaning: the end of a cylinder the rod passes through, which holds its rod seal and its wiper

name: cylinder end cap
meaning: the head that closes a hydraulic cylinder's tube at its other end

name: cylinder mount
meaning: the eye, the clevis or the base by which a cylinder is fixed to its machine

name: vibration damping element
meaning: a part that takes the energy out of a vibration

name: torsional vibration damper
meaning: a ring and a hub joined by an elastic layer, fixed on a crankshaft to damp its twisting vibration

name: damper ring
meaning: the elastic ring, of rubber, between a damper's inertia ring and its hub
